Marcelina Podlińska (born 27 May 1999) is a Polish tennis player. Podlińska has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 579, achieved on 13 October 2025, and a best doubles ranking of world No. 462, achieved on 13 October 2025. [ 1 ] Podlińska played at the Oklahoma Sooners between 2019 and 2022 in the NCAA tennis championships . [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] Podlińska won her first W75 title at the 2025 Ladies Open Vienna in the doubles draw, partnering with Gina Feistel .
